mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log ( user_id, username, role_code, module, operation, description, request_method, request_url, ip_address, result, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{username}, #{roleCode}, #{module}, #{operation}, #{description}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUrl}, #{ipAddress}, #{result}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.storage_time >= CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.storage_time >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthCount, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM express e WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.storage_time IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM operation_log ol WHERE ol.user_id = #{userId} AND ol.module = '快递入库' AND ol.operation = '完成入库' AND ol.result = 'SUCCESS' AND (SUBSTRING(ol.description, 4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = e.express_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci OR SUBSTRING(ol.description, 4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CAST(e.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) )
